scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function rm(p){try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true})}catch{}}function walk(dir){for(const e of fs.readdirSync(dir,{withFileTypes:true})){const full=path.join(dir,e.name);if(e.name==='node_modules'||e.name==='.next'||e.name==='dist'){rm(full)}else if(e.isDirectory()&&e.name!=='.git'){walk(full)}}}walk('.')"
